description: For every language \(L\), \(T_\Gamma\) is unsatisfiable exactly when a finite subset of its ground-instance theory in the fixed fresh-constant language \(L(d)\) is propositionally unsatisfiable.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.fresh_constant_finite_obstruction.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Matrix L)) :
  ¬(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.universalTheory Γ).IsSatisfiable ↔
    ∃ Δ,
      ↑Δ ⊆
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundTheory
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.mapMatrix
                (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.freshInclusion L) ''
              Γ) ∧
        ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Satisfiable Δ
